weight identity W~^T S S^T W_hat = 0.5 W~^T S S^T W~ + 0.5 (W_hat^T S)^2 - 0.5 (W*^T S)^2

no bound relating achieved cost to J*; near-optimality not a theorem
Y_min = 0 because S S^T is rank one (p=5), hence ell=0 and the comparison lemma / bound sqrt(2*varpi/ell) fail

identifier targets depend on u (via Theta_3) and on F_L / controller weights, which are not in the declared NN inputs; ideal weights are not well-defined functions of the inputs
